assignment.rule: persistent, by account: bucket = first 7 hex digits of md5(account_id || ':ridgeview_winback_14d') mod 100; bucket < 15 is the holdout, computed in the daily queue query and pushed on the trigger event as in_holdout; holdout members enter, then exit at holdout_split, so both arms are the same population

primary_metric.description: created a report (feature_used where feature = reports) within 30 days of entry, treatment vs holdout, both arms counted from their entry date
